instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Completes a queue authority handshake. Only the staged pending authority may call
this, promoting itself to the queue authority.

instructions.name: accept_program_authority
docs: Completes the ProgramAuthority handshake. Only the pending authority may call this,
promoting itself to the program authority.

instructions.name: cancel_withdraw
docs: Cancels a withdraw request and returns shares to user
* `RequestDeadlineNotPassed` - If request deadline hasn't passed yet
* `InvalidShareMint` - If share mint doesn't match queue state

instructions.name: deploy
docs: Deploys a new queue for a vault
* `args` - The deployment arguments containing vault configuration

instructions.name: fulfill_withdraw
docs: Fulfills a withdraw request by transferring assets to user
* `cpi_digest_ix_data` - instruction data passed into the withdraw CPI
* `InvalidWithdrawMint` - If withdraw mint doesn't match request
* `InvalidTokenProgram` - If token program doesn't match mint

accounts.name: vault_asset_data
docs: The vault's asset data for the withdraw mint

accounts.name: price_feed
docs: Price feed for the withdraw asset

accounts.name: allowed_user
docs: The queue's `AllowedUser` in the vault program, forwarded to the vault withdraw CPI. The
queue is the withdraw signer; in compliance mode it must be an enabled allowed user.

accounts.name: user_allowed_user
docs: The recipient's (`withdraw_request.user`) `AllowedUser` in the vault program.
Required only when the vault is in compliance mode, `None` otherwise.

accounts.name: cpi_digest
docs: The vault's `CpiDigest` for the withdraw sidecar. Required when the withdraw asset

accounts.name: ix_program_id
docs: Target program of the withdraw sidecar CPI. Required when the withdraw asset

accounts.name: target_program_data
docs: ProgramData of the sidecar target program. Required when the vault's withdraw `CpiDigest`
is bound to the target program's deployed code, `None` otherwise.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pauses the queue, preventing new withdraw requests

instructions.name: request_withdraw
docs: Requests a withdrawal from the queue
- vault_id: The vault to withdraw from
- share_amount: Amount of shares to withdraw
* `InvalidShareMint` - If share mint doesn't match queue state
* `InvalidDiscount` - If discount is outside allowed range
* `InvalidShareAmount` - If share amount is below minimum

accounts.name: boring_vault_state
docs: Mutable: for VestingYield vaults the `vest_to_exchange_rate` CPI persists pending gains
into this account before the rate is read.
Constrained to the vault PDA for `args.vault_id` and to this queue's share mint.

accounts.name: queue_permission
docs: The queue PDA's permission in the vault. Required for VestingYield vaults so the queue can

accounts.name: vault_asset_data
docs: The vault's asset data for the withdraw mint, used to price the quote.

accounts.name: price_feed
docs: Price feed for the withdraw asset.

instructions.name: set_solve_authority
docs: Sets the solve authority for the queue

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Stages a new authority for a queue. Only the current queue authority may call this.
The transfer only takes effect once `pending_authority` calls `accept_authority`,
so a typo'd or unusable key cannot lock the queue out.
* `pending_authority` - The proposed next queue authority or the default pubkey

instructions.name: transfer_program_authority
docs: Stages a new ProgramConfig authority. Only the current program authority may call this.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Unpauses the queue, allowing new withdraw requests

instructions.name: update_withdraw_asset_data
docs: * `InvalidDiscount` - If maximum_discount is less than minimum_discount

errors.name: UnsupportedWithdrawSidecar
errors.msg: Withdraw sidecar CPI not supported by queue

errors.name: UserNotAllowed
errors.msg: User is not an allowed (compliant) user

errors.name: IncompatibleWithdrawAuthority
errors.msg: Vault withdraw authority is not compatible with this queue

errors.name: MissingQueuePermission

fields.name: asset_mint

fields.name: oracle_source
docs: Oracle implementation with encapsulated parameters and addresses

types.name: OracleSource
docs: Enumerates the supported on-chain oracle adapters with their addresses and parameters.

fields.name: feed_address
docs: The canonical price feed account address

fields.name: max_conf_width_bps
docs: Maximum allowed confidence as basis points of price (e.g., 500 = 5%)

- `0` => only `Full` verification is accepted (default, most secure).
`num_signatures` is at least this value (`Full` always qualifies too).
- `1` is rejected by an operational guard: partial verification must

fields.name: feed_address
docs: The canonical price feed account address

fields.name: max_conf_width_bps
docs: Maximum allowed confidence as basis points of price (e.g., 500 = 5%)

fields.name: min_verification_level
docs: Required Pyth verification level. Same encoding as [`PythV2`].

types.name: Permission
docs: PDA account that stores permissions for
a given key on a given vault.

fields.name: vault_id
docs: The vault ID used to derive this permission's parent vault.

fields.name: owner
docs: The key that is granted these permissions

fields.name: can_pause
docs: Flag for whether this key can pause a vault or not

fields.name: can_update_exchange_rate
docs: Flag for whether this key has the Exchange Rate Updater role

fields.name: strategist_group
docs: Bit masking that designates a unique grouping for strategist actions available corresponding with CPI Digest.

fields.name: decimals
docs: The share mint's decimals (set to the base mint's decimals during deployment).

fields.name: platform_fees_owed_in_base_asset
docs: Platform fees accrued and awaiting claim, in base-asset atoms.

fields.name: performance_fees_owed_in_base_asset
docs: Performance fees accrued and awaiting claim, in base-asset atoms.

fields.name: last_strategist_update_timestamp
docs: The last time vest_yield or post_loss was called; gates their minimum-update-delay.

fields.name: state_last_update_timestamp
docs: Advanced inside `accrue_platform_fee` on every fee accrual

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Maximum total share supply allowed via deposits (denominated in shares).

fields.name: minimum_vest_duration
docs: Minimum allowed `vest_yield` streaming duration in seconds

fields.name: maximum_vest_duration
docs: Maximum allowed `vest_yield` streaming duration in seconds

fields.name: platform_fee_remainder
docs: Sub-atom platform fee carry: the part of the accrued platform fee that did not bridge a
whole base-asset atom, scaled by `FEE_REMAINDER_SCALE`. Always `< FEE_REMAINDER_SCALE`.

fields.name: performance_fee_remainder
docs: Sub-atom performance fee carry. Same contract as `platform_fee_remainder`.

fields.name: accounting_paused
docs: Halts accounting operations and anything related: deposit, withdraw, exchange-rate updates,
vesting, safe rate reads, claim fees, and share mint/burn.

fields.name: lock_duration_seconds
docs: Share-lock duration in seconds. Must be the source of truth and driver over the
lock_duration_seconds field on the transfer HookConfig

fields.name: last_virtual_share_price
docs: High-precision, dimensionless virtual share price: the raw ratio
Gains are added here per-share as they vest; the human-readable
exchange_rate (= lastSharePrice in EVM) is derived as

fields.name: vesting_gains
docs: Total unvested gains in base-asset units (not per-share).
Set to the full yield_amount on each vest_yield call (= overwrite, not +=).

fields.name: last_vesting_update
docs: The last time a yield update was posted

fields.name: start_vesting_time
docs: The start time for the yield streaming period

fields.name: end_vesting_time
docs: The end time for the yield streaming period

fields.name: cumulative_supply
docs: Accumulated supply * time for TWAS calculation

fields.name: vesting_period_start
docs: Start of the current TWAS window, reset by vest_yield

fields.name: vault_id
docs: The vault ID used in this account's PDA derivation.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: The withdrawal mint used in this account's PDA derivation.
